title: Grateful Dead Live at Metropolitan Sports Center on 1989-04-17
source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging)

ai_review.summary: Good matrix capture of a beloved final Minnesota show, though vocals sit a bit high in the mix.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise the performance – noting it was the Dead's last concert in Minnesota and calling the show "brilliant" – while the recording is generally solid but has a slightly harsh vocal balance that some listeners find too prominent. The matrix source delivers an enjoyable listening experience, even if a pure audience tape may sound more natural to audiophiles.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong show appreciation (5‑star sentiment) combined with minor mix complaints leads to a solid overall rating; two consistent reviews give moderate confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Vocals are slightly elevated and stark in the mix, making it less natural than a pure audience recording, but the matrix capture is overall clear and listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fans highlight that this was the last Dead show in Minnesota and generally enjoyed the performance, indicating a positive overall flow.
